about: 仓里每一份 ora 样本「解开 → 再编（wroteWith=golden）」得到的 stack.xml 字符串和条目名单。生成 = 改 ora 图层 id 之前的代码（画画仓 3c3fe37 = v0.14.88）。守 test/ora-ids-unchanged.test.mjs：正常文档（id 都可用、不重复）写出来和以前逐字节一样（CatsUp 统筹 11-12）。created 2026-11-12 by Claude Opus 5.5

  <stack name="root">
    <layer name="点" src="data/layer2.png" x="3" y="3" opacity="1.0000" visibility="visible" composite-op="svg:src-over" weebpaint:id="2" weebpaint:active="true" />
    <layer name="底" src="data/layer1.png" x="0" y="0" opacity="1.0000" visibility="visible" composite-op="svg:src-over" weebpaint:id="1" />
  </stack>
</image>
